component.name: hassdash4linux
component.summary: Home Assistant in your system tray

description.p: hassdash4linux puts your Home Assistant at your fingertips: a tray icon whose menu holds the things you use most.

ul.li: Run automations, scenes, scripts and buttons with one click
Control lights (brightness, color temperature, color) and outlets
See live sensor values, such as temperatures, right in the menu
Receive Home Assistant notifications on your desktop, including action buttons

description.p: It logs in through your browser, keeps its credentials in the system keyring, and uses very little memory and CPU while running in the background.
